name: Aditya Shinde
bio:
Founder at Ketoy. Android Developer with over 5 years of experience specializing in Android and Kotlin Multiplatform.

Deeply in the Android community, having delivered 20+ speaker sessions and workshops across Android, FlutterFlow, and Kotlin Multiplatform to over 3,000 attendees.

Runs the Android-focused YouTube channel @DeveloperChunk (1,000+ subscribers) and publishes technical deep-dives on Medium under the same handle.
